description:
Every big company wants you to think their loyalty program is just a way for you to save money, but the truth is they're also giant surveillance systems.

You think you're just getting 10% off, but a company like Macy's might end up with your search history and license plate—and use it to price-gouge you. 

Report by Stephanie Nguyen and Samuel Levine.

Host & Editor: Andrew Rivera
Expert Interview: Stephanie Nguyen
Videographer: Addison Post
Coordinating producer: Nicole Bardasz
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: The Corporate Ripoff Scheme You Need to Know About
